name: visualizer
description: Pad visualizer: hold Note, Instrument, FX1 and FX2 while a pattern plays (Pattern screen, record off) and the pads show drifting smoke with ripples from the notes; press any of the four to go back

branches.note: app_audio_block: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600aa858); the take's clock, a reset at each take's start, the smoke easing

words.note: ITCM image (copied to ITCM 0x1f81c at boot): the word seq_tick's veneer jumps through to seq_advance_step 0x600ad011 -> mt_vz_advance_step (a ripple per note)
pad LED object vtable: setPad 0x600a1bf1 -> mt_vz_set_pad (the firmware's pad writes are dropped while the visualizer shows)
pad LED driver vtable: flush 0x60092931 -> mt_vz_flush (while the visualizer shows, only the changed brightness bytes go out over I2C)
Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_vz_pattern_update (draws the frames, shows and hides)
Pattern screen buttons: Note callback 0x600d20ad (id 0x12) -> mt_vz_note
Pattern screen buttons: Instrument callback 0x600d4495 (id 0x13) -> mt_vz_instrument
Pattern screen buttons: FX1 callback 0x600e308d (id 0x14) -> mt_vz_fx1
Pattern screen buttons: FX2 callback 0x600e2fad (id 0x15) -> mt_vz_fx2
